content.title: Is Home Depot open on Easter?
content.text: If you have home improvement project plans on Sunday, you need to know Home Depot’s hours.Apr 5, 2026 8:08 AM EDTShutterstockKey PointsHome Depot is open on more days than many retailers.The store only closes on a handful of days each year.Home Depot commands more than 50% of the home improvement market. Weekends are for home projects, and Easter weekend is no different than any other for plenty of Americans. Whether this Sunday includes yard work, closet organizing or other spring cleaning, Home Depot likely has many of the supplies you need to get the jobs done. So you’ll be happy to know that The Home Depot will be open for business on Sunday, April 5. According to the Home Depot website, stores will be open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Home Depot has seen a decline in foot traffic in recent years.Photo by M. Suhail on Getty Images Home Depot only closes two days a year Home Depot is one of those stores that rarely closes. In fact, Home Depot only closes two days each year: Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. Home Depot, Inc. accounts for 52.4% of the home improvement market ($149.5 billion a year), according to data from IBISWorld. Still, visits to Home Depot have been down, so the company needs to keep its doors open as many days as possible. Home Depot’s foot traffic declined about 3.8% year over year in Q1 2026, according to Placer.ai data shared on Yahoo Finance. Other stores open on Easter Sunday Home Depot is open on Easter, which is good news if you’re planning to tackle home projects. And even though the Home Depot website says stores are open on Easter, use the Home Depot locator to make sure your store is. Plenty of other major retailers are also open. Kroger is open normal hours, but pharmacies are closed. Harris Teeter stores are open normal hours. Meijer stores are open from 6 a.m. to midnight. Stop and Shop locations are open from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m., but pharmacies are closed. Trader Joe’s plans to be open regular business hours. Walmart is open normal hours.
